title: SimPoly: Simulation of polymers with machine learning force fields derived from first principles
summary_zh: 本文开发了一种基于第一原理的机器学习力场，用于聚合物模拟。方法上，仅使用量子化学计算训练力场，预测了多种聚合物的宏观性质。实验表明，该力场在预测聚合物密度方面与经典力场相当或更准确。
summary_en: This paper develops a machine learning force field derived from first principles for polymer simulation. The method trains the force field using quantum-chemical calculations alone, predicting bulk properties across a range of polymers. Experiments show that this force field is as accurate or more accurate in predicting polymer densities than established classical force fields.
insights: 创新点：基于第一原理开发机器学习力场
方法亮点：仅使用量子化学计算训练力场
关键发现：力场在预测聚合物密度方面表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Developing a machine learning force field based on first principles
Method highlight: Training the force field using only quantum-chemical calculations
Key finding: The force field excels in predicting polymer densities
abstract: Polymers are a versatile class of materials with widespread industrial applications. Advanced computational tools could revolutionize their design, but the complex, multi-scale nature of polymers poses significant modeling challenges. Classical force fields often lack the accuracy and transferability that polymers demand, while quantum-chemical methods are prohibitively expensive for the large systems and long timescales involved. Here we develop a fast, scalable machine learning force field and show that, trained on quantum-chemical calculations alone, without any experimental data, it predicts measured bulk properties across a broad range of polymers. It reproduces polymer densities as accurately as, or better than, established classical force fields and captures the glass transition signature in the density-temperature curve, enabling the prediction of glass transition temperatures. To accelerate progress in this domain, we release a benchmark of experimental bulk properties for 130 polymers and an accompanying quantum-chemical dataset, laying the foundation for a fully in silico design pipeline for next-generation polymeric materials. The authors develop a machine learning force field trained only on quantum-chemical data that can reproduce measured key polymer properties such as densities and glass transition temperatures.

title: AnyNav: Visual neuro-symbolic friction learning for off-road navigation
summary_zh: 研究越野导航问题。提出基于神经符号的视觉摩擦估计和导航框架。结合视觉感知和物理模型。
summary_en: Studies off-road navigation. Introduces a vision-based friction estimation and navigation framework grounded in neuro-symbolic principles. Integrates visual perception with a physical model.
insights: 创新点：结合视觉感知和物理模型
方法亮点：神经符号方法应用于导航
关键发现：提高导航在复杂环境中的泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates visual perception with a physical model
Method highlight: Applies neuro-symbolic methods to navigation
Key finding: Improves navigation generalization in complex environments
abstract: Off-road navigation is critical for a wide range of field robotics applications from planetary exploration to disaster response. However, it remains a longstanding challenge due to unstructured environments and the inherently complex terrain–vehicle interactions. Traditional physics-based methods struggle to accurately capture the nonlinear dynamics underlying these interactions, while purely data-driven approaches often overfit to specific motion patterns, vehicle geometries, or platforms, limiting their generalization in diverse, real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce AnyNav, a vision-based friction estimation and navigation framework grounded in neuro-symbolic principles. Our approach integrates neural networks for visual perception with symbolic physical models for reasoning about terrain-vehicle dynamics. To enable learning in a self-supervised manner for real-world settings, we adopt the imperative learning paradigm, where a bilevel optimization framework leverages physics-based optimization for training the friction network. This explicit incorporation of physical reasoning substantially improves generalization across terrains, vehicle types, and operating conditions. Leveraging the predicted friction coefficients, we further develop a physics-informed navigation system capable of generating physically feasible, time-efficient paths together with corresponding speed profiles. We demonstrate that AnyNav seamlessly transfers from simulation to real-world robotic platforms, exhibiting strong robustness across different four-wheeled vehicles and diverse off-road environments.

title: Odyssey: An automotive lidar-inertial odometry dataset with GNSS-denied situations
summary_zh: 本文提出Odyssey数据集，用于LIO和SLAM系统评估。数据集包含长时间GNSS拒绝环境下的LIO数据，弥补了现有数据集的不足。
summary_en: This paper presents the Odyssey dataset for evaluating LIO and SLAM systems. The dataset contains LIO data under prolonged GNSS-denied situations, addressing the limitations of existing datasets.
insights: 创新点：提出Odyssey数据集，解决GNSS拒绝环境下的LIO评估问题。
方法亮点：提供长时间GNSS拒绝环境下的LIO数据。
关键发现：数据集弥补了现有数据集的不足。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the Odyssey dataset to address LIO evaluation under GNSS-denied situations.
Method highlight: Provides LIO data under prolonged GNSS-denied situations.
Key finding: The dataset addresses the limitations of existing datasets.
abstract: The development and evaluation of Lidar-Inertial Odometry (LIO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems require a precise reference trajectory. The Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) is often used as a foundation for this, but its signals can be unreliable in obstructed environments due to multi-path effects or loss-of-signal. While existing datasets compensate for sporadic GNSS loss by incorporating Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements, the commonly used systems do not permit prolonged study of GNSS-denied environments due to accumulated drift. Consequently, existing automotive benchmarks are typically restricted to short GNSS-denied segments. To close this gap, we present Odyssey, an automotive LIO dataset featuring: (1) prolonged, previously unseen GNSS-denied environments with reference trajectories enabled by a navigation-grade Ring Laser Gyroscope (RLG)-based RTK/INS; (2) a large and diverse collection of 36 sequences that range from rural outdoor environments to urban and indoor scenarios; and (3) experimentally validated uncertainties, allowing for precise quantification of reference error. Besides providing data for LIO, Odyssey also supports place recognition tasks through threefold trajectory repetition and integration of external mapping data via precise geodetic coordinates. All data, dataloader and supplementary material are available online at https://odyssey.uni-goettingen.de/ .

title: Spontaneous gas film expansion at an oil–water interface
summary_zh: 研究揭示了油水界面自发形成气膜的现象。方法上，通过微结构限制和气泡引入，实现气膜形成。实验表明，气膜的形成降低了局部压力，促进了溶解空气的吸收。
summary_en: This study reveals the spontaneous formation of a gas film at an oil-water interface. The method involves microstructural confinement and bubble introduction to achieve gas film formation. Experiments show that the formation of the gas film lowers local pressure, promoting the uptake of dissolved air.
insights: 创新点：揭示油水界面自发形成气膜的现象
方法亮点：微结构限制和气泡引入实现气膜形成
关键发现：气膜的形成降低了局部压力，促进了溶解空气的吸收
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the spontaneous formation of a gas film at an oil-water interface
Method highlight: Microstructural confinement and bubble introduction to achieve gas film formation
Key finding: The formation of the gas film lowers local pressure, promoting the uptake of dissolved air
abstract: Spontaneous interfacial separation of oil and water, by inserting a gas film between the two liquids, is thermodynamically unfavorable because the oil–water interface is replaced by oil–gas and water–gas interfaces with a higher combined interfacial energy. Here, we demonstrate that microstructural confinement enables this transition after bubble introduction through the coupling of wetting, capillarity, and gas transport. Spontaneous oil imbibition into a water-submerged micropillar array, together with local contact-line pinning, deforms the oil–water interface into a metastable meniscus and generates a local pressure deficit in the confined oil. This deficit, combined with the bubble’s interfacial configuration, lowers its air partial pressure and promotes dissolved-air uptake from the surrounding water. Geometric confinement, reduced oil pressure, and low oil–gas interfacial tension favor bubble lateral invasion of adjacent oil-filled cells over vertical extrusion. As the gas front advances, meniscus relaxation and oil redistribution promote further wetting, renewing the capillary conditions that support gas film propagation. We develop a coupled transport-capillarity framework that captures these morphological transitions and predicts a characteristic timescale for gas film evolution, determined by the interaction among geometry, capillarity, and gas-phase transport. Spatially varying the microstructure further controls the propagation pathway and morphology of the gas film. These findings show how favorable wetting can support an energetically costly interfacial transformation through a confinement-induced capillary pressure field, providing a general mechanism for gas-mediated separation in confined multiphase systems.

title: Compliant residual DAgger: Improving real-world contact-rich manipulation with human corrections
summary_zh: 研究数据聚合挑战。引入CR-DAgger，提高接触丰富操作性能。
summary_en: Studies challenges in Dataset Aggregation. Introduces CR-DAgger to enhance performance on contact-rich manipulation tasks.
insights: 创新点：CR-DAgger框架
方法亮点：合规干预接口
关键发现：性能提升64%
insights_en: Novelty: CR-DAgger framework
Method highlight: Compliant Intervention Interface
Key finding: Performance improvement by 64%
abstract: We address key challenges in Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) for real-world contact-rich manipulation: how to collect informative human correction data and how to effectively update policies with this new data. We introduce Compliant Residual DAgger (CR-DAgger), which contains two novel components: (1) a Compliant Intervention Interface that leverages compliance control, allowing humans to provide gentle, accurate delta action corrections without interrupting the ongoing robot policy execution; and (2) a Compliant Residual Policy formulation that learns from human corrections while incorporating force feedback and force control. Our system significantly enhances performance on precise contact-rich manipulation tasks using minimal correction data, improving base policy success rates by 64% on four challenging tasks (book flipping, belt assembly, cable routing, and gear insertion) while outperforming both retraining-from-scratch and finetuning approaches. Through extensive real-world experiments, we provide practical guidance for implementing effective DAgger in real-world robot learning tasks. Result videos are available at: https://compliant-residual-dagger.github.io/ .

title: MariSense: A multi-modal dataset for environmental perception in maritime autonomy
summary_zh: 本文提出MariSense数据集，用于海上自主导航的环境感知研究。数据集包含多模态数据，如毫米波雷达，以应对海上感知挑战。
summary_en: This paper presents the MariSense dataset for environmental perception research in maritime autonomy. The dataset includes multi-modal data, such as mmWave radar, to address maritime perception challenges.
insights: 创新点：提出MariSense数据集，应对海上感知挑战。
方法亮点：整合多模态数据，如毫米波雷达。
关键发现：数据集有助于海上自主导航研究。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the MariSense dataset to address maritime perception challenges.
Method highlight: Integrates multi-modal data, such as mmWave radar.
Key finding: The dataset aids in maritime autonomy research.
abstract: Maritime autonomous navigation enables unmanned surface vehicles to perform multiple tasks and can also serve as a driver-assistance system for manned vessels, improving safety and comfort. Compared with on-road scenes, maritime perception faces unique challenges: optical sensors degrade due to reflections and sea fog, while wind and waves cause large platform motions that disrupt perception stability. Therefore, high-quality multi-modal datasets are crucial. Meanwhile, 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has been successfully applied in on-road scenes due to its all-weather, all-day, and high-resolution sensing capabilities, but its maritime characteristics and waveform design effects remain underexplored. To address these challenges, we present MariSense, a multi-modal dataset for maritime autonomy perception. MariSense is the first to introduce the concept of dynamic waveform 4D mmWave radar into maritime scenes, integrating multi-waveform radars with visible and thermal cameras, LiDAR, marine radar, Automatic Identification System (AIS), and navigation sensors, all with extrinsic calibration. The dataset covers various scenes such as anchorages and fairways under varying weather, time, and sea conditions. We establish benchmarks for object detection, tracking, and odometry, and evaluate baseline methods, highlighting the need for improved maritime perception, multi-modal fusion, and adaptive 4D mmWave radar waveform design. The dataset can be downloaded from https://github.com/ORCAUBOAT/MariSense .

title: CH2Cl2 emissions from China inferred from atmospheric observations
Engineering filamentous myosins for optical control of contractility
summary_zh: 本文研究通过工程化肌动蛋白控制收缩性。方法上，开发了一种通过蓝光控制收缩性的工具。实验表明，这种工具可以精确控制肌动蛋白的活性。
summary_en: This paper studies engineering filamentous myosins for optical control of contractility. The method develops a tool for optical control of contractility by extending the MyLOV family of gearshifting motors. Experiments show that this tool can precisely control the activity of filamentous myosins.
insights: 创新点：开发光学控制收缩性工具
方法亮点：扩展MyLOV家族齿轮换挡电机
关键发现：精确控制肌动蛋白活性
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a tool for optical control of contractility
Method highlight: Extension of the MyLOV family of gearshifting motors
Key finding: Precise control of filamentous myosin activity
abstract: Understanding the behaviors of contractile actomyosin systems requires precise spatiotemporal control of filamentous myosin activity. Here, we develop a tool for optical control of contractility by extending the MyLOV family of gearshifting motors to create engineered filamentous myosins that change velocity in response to blue light. We characterize these minifilaments using in vitro single-molecule tracking assays, contractility assays in reconstituted actin networks, and imaging of contractile phenotypes in live cells. In vitro, gearshifting minifilaments change speed and/or direction when illuminated, and contraction rates of minifilaments in actin networks can be modulated using blue light. In cells, gearshifting minifilaments enable optical control of protrusion retraction, cortical flow, and cell migration. Finally, we develop an alternative design for minifilaments that only interact processively with actin in blue light. Engineered minifilaments could be used to dissect behaviors such as self-organization and mechanotransduction in contractile systems both in vitro and in cells and tissues. Zemsky and colleagues employ protein engineering to create filamentous myosins controlled by light. These optogenetic motors enable spatiotemporal control of contractility in vitro and in cells, providing a tool for probing contractile actomyosin systems.

title: Pico-X: a 24.9 nanowatt microcontroller for long-duration autonomous operation in flexible landing-pad sensor networks
summary_zh: 研究针对柔性着陆平台传感器网络自主运行需求，设计超低功耗微控制器Pico-X。方法上，采用硅基数字信号处理和通信技术。实验表明，Pico-X实现年尺度电池充电。
summary_en: This study designs an ultra-low-power microcontroller Pico-X for autonomous operation in flexible landing-pad sensor networks. The method employs silicon-based digital signal processing and communication technologies. Experiments show that Pico-X achieves year-scale battery charging.
insights: 创新点：设计超低功耗微控制器Pico-X
方法亮点：结合硅基数字信号处理和通信技术
关键发现：实现年尺度电池充电
insights_en: Novelty: Designing ultra-low-power microcontroller Pico-X
Method highlight: Combining silicon-based digital signal processing and communication technologies
Key finding: Achieving year-scale battery charging
abstract: Abstract The flexible landing-pad arrays in low-altitude infrastructure are embodied by ordinary items, which desirably include sensors, actuators, displays and electronic interface devices in combination with silicon-based digital signal processing and communication technologies. However, autonomous operation in the flexible landing-pad sensor networks is partly hampered due to a lack of ultra-low power level MCU system, which should be responsible for intense communication and precise control among the embodied ordinary items in the landing-pad, as well as communications among the hundreds to thousands pads in the array. At the same time, the battery recharging time is expected to be year-scale. Here, we report Pico-X, ultra-low-power specific-designed processor, which is targeted as a local computer core for flexible sensor arrays on vertiport and landing-pad surfaces. Pico-X adopts specific event-driven operation model of local sampling and decision with exception-only reporting, combined with a power-management strategy employing light forward body bias (FBB) during active operation and zero body bias (ZBB) in sleep mode. The chip is implemented based on 28-nm FDSOI technology. Measurement results demonstrate a minimum power consumption of 24.9 nW at 25 kHz, @VDD = 0.4 V, while maintaining a compact 6.1-k-gate footprint. Pico-X thus provides a programmable and scalable nanowatt-class edge intelligence platform for flexible landing-pad arrays in low-altitude infrastructure.

title: Silicon photonics provides a unified solution for all-distance optical communications
summary_zh: 研究提出统一硅光子解决方案实现全距离光通信。方法上，采用超低损耗硅氮化物外腔。实验表明，该方案实现高光谱效率和容量。
summary_en: This study proposes a unified silicon photonics solution for all-distance optical communications. The method employs an ultralow-loss silicon nitride external cavity. Experiments show that this solution achieves high spectral efficiency and capacity.
insights: 创新点：提出统一硅光子解决方案
方法亮点：采用超低损耗硅氮化物外腔
关键发现：实现高光谱效率和容量
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a unified silicon photonics solution
Method highlight: Employing an ultralow-loss silicon nitride external cavity
Key finding: Achieving high spectral efficiency and capacity
abstract: Optical links underpin global communications from chip-to-chip interconnects to transoceanic fibre networks. Conventional architectures remain distance-dependent: long-haul systems rely on coherent transmission for high spectral efficiency and capacity, while short-reach links favour intensity modulation due to hardware complexity and power constraints. This divide impedes scalability for AI-driven intra-data-centre traffic and low-latency, flexible cloud-to-edge connectivity. Here we demonstrate a unified silicon photonic coherent solution for all-distance optical communications. By employing an ultralow-loss silicon nitride external cavity, we achieve 70 mW of direct laser output with a sub-kHz linewidth and 13.7% wall-plug efficiency. Paired with silicon photonic transceivers, this platform enables short-distance transmission without optical amplification across 256 wavelength channels, corresponding to an aggregate data rate of 81.92 Tb/s, as well as transmission exceeding 4400 km. It also supports wavelength switching and transmission re-establishment at tens-of-microseconds timescales. These results indicate the potential to simplify optical interfaces and enable flexible wavelength-routed connectivity. The authors demonstrate a silicon-photonic coherent platform using a high-power tunable laser and silicon-photonic transceivers, enabling broadband unamplified short-reach transmission, links beyond 4400 km and rapid wavelength switching.

title: Pulsed photoelectrocatalysis enables efficient urea synthesis over Cu(salen)-COF
summary_zh: 研究通过脉冲光电催化实现高效尿素合成。方法上，优化界面微环境结合脉冲电解。实验表明，该方法提高界面电荷转移。
summary_en: This study enables efficient urea synthesis through pulsed photoelectrocatalysis. The method optimizes the interfacial microenvironment combined with pulsed electrolysis. Experiments show that this method enhances interfacial charge transfer.
insights: 创新点：脉冲光电催化实现尿素合成
方法亮点：优化界面微环境结合脉冲电解
关键发现：提高界面电荷转移
insights_en: Novelty: Enabling urea synthesis through pulsed photoelectrocatalysis
Method highlight: Optimizing the interfacial microenvironment combined with pulsed electrolysis
Key finding: Enhancing interfacial charge transfer
abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic urea synthesis from carbon dioxide and nitrate under ambient conditions offers a sustainable alternative to the energy-intensive Bosch-Meiser process. However, its efficiency is constrained by the spatiotemporal mismatch of key carbon and nitrogen intermediates at the catalyst-electrolyte interface. Herein, we address this limitation through interfacial microenvironment optimization combining ionic liquid modification of copper-salen covalent organic framework, pulsed electrolysis, and photoelectrocatalytic coupling. The ionic liquid modification enriches carbon dioxide and facilitates interfacial charge transfer, pulsed electrolysis promotes the dynamic matching of carbon and nitrogen intermediates, and photoelectrocatalytic coupling boosts interfacial electron accumulation. The integrated system achieves a urea yield rate of 69.2 mmol g cat −1 h −1 with a Faradaic efficiency of 56.7% in an H-type cell and 82.5% in a flow cell. In this work, we establish a generalizable strategy for efficient urea electrosynthesis via hierarchical interfacial control and highlight the potential of pulsed photoelectrocatalysis.

title: Entangled-to-packed crossover in nonlinear extensional rheology of entangled polymers
summary_zh: 研究揭示缠结聚合物在强拉伸流动中的转变。方法上，通过分子动力学模拟。实验表明，系统从缠结状态转变为紧密排列状态。
summary_en: This study reveals a crossover from the entangled to a packed state in the nonlinear extensional rheology of entangled polymers. The method involves molecular dynamics simulations. Experiments show that the system transitions from an entangled state to a packed configuration of aligned segments.
insights: 创新点：揭示缠结聚合物转变过程
方法亮点：分子动力学模拟研究
关键发现：系统从缠结状态转变为紧密排列状态
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the transition process in entangled polymers
Method highlight: Molecular dynamics simulations
Key finding: The system transitions from an entangled state to a packed configuration of aligned segments
abstract: The tube model, which reduces the interaction of many-chain entanglement to a single-chain picture, has enabled quantitative descriptions of the mechanical behaviors of polymeric materials and underpins applications from polymer processing to life sciences. In strong extensional flows, however, this theory systematically fails. Herein, through molecular dynamics simulations of entangled polymers, we reveal a strain-induced crossover from the entangled state to a packed state in the inter-chain configuration. Following the saturation of primitive chain stretch, convective disentanglement and chain alignment reorganize the system into a packed configuration of aligned segments. This crossover makes an explicit inter-chain contribution necessary for describing tensile stress beyond the intra-chain conformational stress, explaining the breakdown of tube-based descriptions and quantitatively capturing the mechanical response at large extensional strains. These findings clearly show how the inter-chain reorganization governs the nonlinear extensional behaviors. Entanglements among long-chain macromolecules dictate the mechanical performance of polymeric materials and are described with the tube model but the validity of this model has been questioned for nonlinear extension. Here the authors reveal the key mechanism that governs the mechanical response during extension by elucidating the evolution of entanglements using computer simulations and theoretical analysis.

title: Molecular-level control of nitrogen sites enables CO2 electro-reduction under industrially relevant conditions
summary_zh: 本文研究CO2在稀释条件下的电化学还原。通过调控Ni-N-C单原子催化剂中的吡啶氮，实现高效CO2还原。电子态分析和密度泛函理论揭示了吡啶氮形成可逆的CO2加合物。
summary_en: This paper studies CO2 electro-reduction under dilute conditions. Pyridinic nitrogen in Ni-N-C single-atom catalysts enables efficient CO2 reduction. Electronic-state analysis and density functional theory reveal the formation of a reversible CO2 adduct by pyridinic nitrogen.
insights: 创新点：通过调控吡啶氮实现高效CO2还原
方法亮点：使用电子态分析和密度泛函理论
关键发现：吡啶氮形成可逆的CO2加合物
insights_en: Novelty: Efficient CO2 reduction via pyridinic nitrogen tuning
Method highlight: Electronic-state analysis and density functional theory
Key finding: Pyridinic nitrogen forms a reversible CO2 adduct
abstract: Abstract Industrial flue gases typically contain only 3–15% CO 2 , and direct electrochemical reduction on such dilute feeds would eliminate costly upstream purification. However, mass transport limitations and competing hydrogen evolution severely restrict activity under these CO 2 -starved conditions, and the governing molecular factors remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that pyridinic-nitrogen enrichment in Ni–N–C single-atom catalysts enables efficient CO 2 reduction under dilute CO 2 . By tuning the pyridinic-N to pyrrolic-N ratio in well-defined Ni–N x sites, we probe the role of local nitrogen environments in CO 2 reduction rather than the metal center alone. Electronic-state analysis and density functional theory reveal that pyridinic-N forms a reversible CO 2 adduct that enhances local CO 2 accessibility near the active Ni center through a desorption–re-adsorption relay. These findings provide molecular-level insight by identifying a neighboring motif that regulates local CO 2 availability without perturbing the intrinsic Ni–N reaction pathway, and by establishing a transferable design principle for CO 2 reduction catalysts under CO 2 -limited conditions.

title: Electrolyte-dependent physico-chemical interfacial kinetics shape degradation pathways and lifetime in lithium-ion batteries
summary_zh: 本文研究电解液条件对锂离子电池降解路径和寿命的影响。通过改变溶剂比例，观察到不同电池的寿命轨迹存在差异。
summary_en: This paper studies the impact of electrolyte conditions on degradation pathways and lifetime in lithium-ion batteries. Changing the solvent ratio leads to distinct lifetime trajectories across otherwise comparable cells.
insights: 创新点：电解液条件影响电池寿命
方法亮点：使用多层软包电池进行加速降解测试
关键发现：溶剂比例影响电池寿命轨迹
insights_en: Novelty: Electrolyte conditions affect battery lifetime
Method highlight: Multi-layer pouch cells for accelerated degradation testing
Key finding: Solvent ratio influences battery lifetime trajectories
abstract: Abstract Electrolyte-dependent lifetime variability remains a major obstacle to sustainable deployment of lithium-ion batteries, contributing to premature retirement, increased material demand and uncertainty in lifecycle assessment. However, most continuum degradation models represent the electrolyte through bulk transport, without capturing its role in interfacial degradation. Here, we use customised multi-layer pouch cells with varied ethylene carbonate:dimethyl carbonate ratio, lithium hexafluorophosphate concentration and electrolyte amount to examine how electrolyte conditions shape degradation trajectories under accelerated degradation. Within this formulation framework, changing the solvent ratio leads to distinct lifetime trajectories across otherwise comparable cells. Electrochemical diagnostics, gas analysis and post-mortem interfacial characterisation show that this divergence is associated with electrolyte-sensitive interphase growth, parasitic reactions and spatially heterogeneous surface degradation. We incorporate electrolyte-dependent transport and thermodynamic properties into a physics-based degradation model. A transport-only implementation does not reproduce the observed separation in capacity-retention trajectories. Introducing a minimal electrolyte-sensitive refinement through an effective interphase transport parameter improves agreement in the ethylene-carbonate-rich case. These results identify electrolyte-sensitive interfacial degradation as a necessary modelling dimension for reliable lifetime prediction.

title: Coordination-directed synthesis of two-dimensional metal-organic covalent organic frameworks
summary_zh: 本文研究二维金属有机共价有机框架的合成。通过构建一维配位聚合物，合成了高孔隙率的PUMC-1和PUMC-2。
summary_en: This paper studies the synthesis of two-dimensional metal-organic covalent organic frameworks. High-porosity PUMC-1 and PUMC-2 were synthesized by constructing one-dimensional coordination polymers.
insights: 创新点：二维金属有机共价有机框架的合成
方法亮点：利用三维电子衍射解析形成过程
关键发现：一维配位聚合物构建二维框架
insights_en: Novelty: Synthesis of two-dimensional metal-organic covalent organic frameworks
Method highlight: Utilizing three-dimensional electron diffraction to elucidate the formation process
Key finding: One-dimensional coordination polymers construct two-dimensional frameworks
abstract: Metal-organic covalent organic frameworks (MOCOFs) combine the advantages of covalent and metal-organic frameworks, but research remains sparse due to characterization difficulties, leaving unclear whether their formation is covalent- or coordination-directed. To date, only a few three-dimensional MOCOFs have been reported, while two-dimensional (2D) MOCOFs remain unexplored. Here, we strategically synthesize two single-crystal 2D MOCOFs with high porosity, denoted as PUMC-1 and PUMC-2. Leveraging three-dimensional electron diffraction, we are able to elucidate their formation process in detail. First, one-dimensional coordination polymers (1D CPs) are constructed from two sub-building units: tetrakis(4-aminophenyl) porphyrin and cobalt(II) trans-A₂B₂ porphyrin. Second, 1D CPs with covalent extension sites are used to construct two distinct 2D MOCOF conformations via covalent self-assembly under different conditions. Notably, the same 2D MOCOFs can also be directly obtained via one-pot synthesis with the same monomers, providing experimental evidence for a coordination-directed covalent assembly mechanism. This work not only expands the dimensionality of MOCOFs but also opens new avenues in reticular chemistry. Metal-organic covalent organic frameworks (MOCOFs) combine the advantages of covalent and metal-organic frameworks, but two-dimensional (2D) MOCOFs remain unexplored. Here, the authors synthesize two 2D MOCOFs with high porosity and elucidate their formation process in detail.
